game.name: Stuntman : Ignition (Australia)(Demo)
game.desc: In Stuntman: Ignition for Xbox 360, play as a young up-and-coming Hollywood stuntman and prove yourself to land big-budget productions and lucrative contracts. Travel through over 40 levels in the career mode and experience six productions, each divided into six epic action scenes. You'll need to master 25 different vehicles to keep the show going. You can share the limelight in multiplayer mode.
